2653-2893-4826-8336.description:
Activate Fertilid by paying {1}{G} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, causing you to search your library for a basic land card and put it on the battlefield untapped due to Archelos.
When the basic land enters, Nissa and Amanda Grayson trigger.
Resolve the Nissa trigger, adding {G}.
Resolve the Amanda Grayson trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on Fertilid.
Activate the basic land by tapping it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

3469-5261-7329.easyPrerequisites:
Your deck size is 2 or greater.
Energy Arc is exiled by Isochron Scepter.
Isochron Scepter doesn't have summoning sickness.
3469-5261-7329.notablePrerequisites: Creatures you control can tap to produce at least {2}.
3469-5261-7329.description:
Animate Isochron Scepter using Mind Transfer Protocol.
Activate any number of creatures by tapping them, adding at least {2}.
Activate Isochron Scepter by paying {2} and tapping it, casting a copy of Energy Arc without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Energy Arc, untapping all creatures you control
Repeat from step 2.

647-2023-4770-6006.description:
Cast Whitemane Lion by paying its mana cost.
Aragorn triggers, creating a 1/1 Human Soldier creature token.
When Whitemane Lion enters, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Whitemane Lion and the Human Soldier token by tapping them, adding {1}{W}.
Resolve the Whitemane Lion ability, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

2137-4642-4885.description:
Cast Awaken the Woods with X equal to 3 by paying {3}{G}{G}.
Holding priority, activate Uyo by paying {2} and returning two lands you control to their owner's hand, copying Awaken the Woods.
Resolve the copy of Awaken the Woods, creating three 1/1 Forest Dryad land creature tokens.
Activate two Forest Dryads by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Repeat from step 2.
2137-4642-4885.notes: Once you have infinite green mana and infinite land tokens, you may activate Uyo any number of times, targeting any number of instant or sorcery spells.

4613-4654-8227.easyPrerequisites:
Loot doesn't have summoning sickness and has a +1/+1 counter on it.
Hyalopterous Lemure is exiled by Agatha's Soul Cauldron.
4613-4654-8227.description:
Activate Loot using Hyalopterous Lemure's ability by paying {0}, giving Loot -1/-0 until end of turn.
Repeat an arbitrarily large number of times.
Deal combat damage with Loot. Due to its static effect, it will treat its power as positive when assigning combat damage.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

4247-4574-6972.easyPrerequisites: You have an artifact card in your graveyard.
4247-4574-6972.description:
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing Arcbound Reclaimer.
When Arcbound Reclaimer dies, its modular ability and persist ability trigger.
Resolve the modular trigger, putting Arcbound Reclaimer's +1/+1 counters on another artifact creature.
Resolve the persist trigger, returning Arcbound Reclaimer from your graveyard to the battlefield. It will not have a -1/-1 counter on it due to its modular ability.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability.
Repeat.
Activate Arcbound Reclaimer by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, targeting an artifact card in your graveyard.
If needed, hold priority and repeat step 1 until Arcbound Reclaimer dies as a state-based action due to having 0 toughness.
When Arcbound Reclaimer dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with two +1/+1 counters on it due to its modular ability.
Holding priority, repeat from step 1.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with three or more +1/+1 counters on it

2122-7737-7741.description:
Activate Mindless Automaton by removing two +1/+1 counters from it, causing you to draw a card.
Stark's Ingenuity triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on Mindless Automaton due to Shang-Chi
Repeat.

671-3375-4399-4518.description:
Cast Kor Skyfisher by paying {0} and 2 life due to Defiler of Faith and The Immortal Sun.
Defiler of Faith triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Daxos triggers, causing you to gain life.
Resolve Kor Skyfisher. When it enters, it and Daxos trigger.
Resolve the Kor Skyfisher trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Daxos trigger, causing you to gain life.
Repeat.
671-3375-4399-4518.notes: If your life total is below 3 to start, instead pay {W} when casting Kor Skyfisher for the first time.

1394-2060-2921-7038-7741.description:
Play Power Depot, which will enter with a +1/+1 counter on it due to its modular ability
Cast Toph either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {2}{R}{G} plus commander tax if applicable.
When Toph enters, it triggers, earthbending Power Depot and putting a number of +1/+1 counters on Power Depot equal to the mana spent to cast Toph, increased by Shang-Chi.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Power Depot.
When Power Depot dies, its modular ability and Toph trigger.
Resolve the modular trigger, putting the +1/+1 counters that were on Power Depot onto Crystalline Crawler, increased by Shang-Chi.
Resolve the Toph trigger, returning Power Depot from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped. Power Depot will enter with a +1/+1 counter on it due to its modular ability
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Toph. Choose to return Toph from your graveyard to the command zone.
Activate Crystalline Crawler by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {R/G}.
Repeat step 10 until you have enough mana to cast Toph.
Repeat from step 2.

6848-6849-7666.easyPrerequisites:
You have a way to proliferate or a way to put a +1/+1 counter on Bloodcrazed Hoplite after an opponent gains control of it.
An opponent controls a creature.
6848-6849-7666.description:
Donate control of Bloodcrazed Hoplite to an opponent.
Put a +1/+1 counter on Bloodcrazed Hoplite either by proliferating or by any other method.
Bloodcrazed Hoplite triggers, targeting any creature controlled by you or another opponent.
When the opponent commits that crime, Patrolling Peacemaker triggers, causing you to proliferate and put a +1/+1 counter on Bloodcrazed Hoplite.
Repeat from step 3.

2034-4871-6476-7487.notablePrerequisites: You have at least two opponents that each have a creature card that will enter the battlefield with greater than 0 toughness in their graveyard.
2034-4871-6476-7487.description:
Cast Afterlife from the Loam by paying at most {5}{B}{B}{B}, returning Zealous Lorecaster and at least two other creatures from graveyards to the battlefield under your control.
When Zealous Lorecaster enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Afterlife from the Loam from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate Ashnod's Altar four times by sacrificing three of the creatures returned in step 1, adding six {C}.
When the creatures die, Pitiless Plunderer triggers four times, creating three Treasure tokens.
Activate the three Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Repeat.

1162-7416.notablePrerequisites:
Angelic Enforcer does not have summoning sickness.
Your life total is higher than or equal to an opponent's.
You have Professor Dellian Fel's emblem.
1162-7416.description:
Declare Angelic Enforcer as an attacker.
Angelic Enforcer triggers, doubling your life total.
Professor Dellian Fel's emblem triggers, causing target opponent whose life total is less than or equal to Angelic Enforcer's power to lose life equal to the life you gained.
That opponent loses the game due to having 0 or less life.

147-2292-5188.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in your graveyard.
147-2292-5188.description:
Cast Dread Return by paying its mana cost
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, targeting Dread Return.
Holding priority, activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the Dualcaster Mage trigger, copying Dread Return
Resolve the Dread Return copy, returning Dualcaster Mage from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

339-677-4460-6798.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Jegantha.
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

1385-4681-5147-5170.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Karmic Guide.
When Karmic Guide dies, Zulaport Cutthroat triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Junji.
When Junji dies, it and Zulaport Cutthroat trigger.
Resolve the Zulaport Cutthroat trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Junji trigger, returning Karmic Guide from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to lose 2 life.
When Karmic Guide enters, it triggers, returning Junji from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Repeat.

729-1170-1329-4708.description:
Activate Emry by tapping it, targeting Dark Sphere.
Cast Dark Sphere from your graveyard by paying {0}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Great Oak Guardian.
When Great Oak Guardian enters, it triggers, untapping all creatures you control and giving them +2/+2 until end of turn.
Activate Dark Sphere by tapping and sacrificing it.
Repeat.

2866-3518-4986-5147.description:
Cast Lion's Eye Diamond by paying its mana cost.
Teshar triggers, returning Scrap Trawler from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Lion's Eye Diamond by discarding your hand and sacrificing it.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Scrap Trawler.
When Scrap Trawler dies, it triggers, returning Lion's Eye Diamond from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Repeat.

3234-3293-5256-5411.easyPrerequisites: You control a Plains or have a Plains in your graveyard.
3234-3293-5256-5411.description:
Activate Need for Speed by sacrificing a land.
Repeat step 1 until you control no lands.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing World Shaper.
When World Shaper dies, it triggers, return all lands from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the lands enter, Emeria Shepherd triggers that many times.
Resolve an Emeria Shepherd trigger that was triggered by a Plains, returning World Shaper from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve all remaining Emeria Shepherd triggers.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Repeat
3234-3293-5256-5411.notes: You can return all nonland permanents in your graveyard and library to the battlefield if you control there are two or more Plains between your graveyard, library and battlefield. To do this, have all triggers from Emeria Shepherd target desired permanents. Then, resolve the Plains triggers first to return those cards to the battlefield, causing all other triggers to fizzle on the stack.

1636-5914-6022.notablePrerequisites: Creatures you control can tap to produce at least {1}{G}{U}.
1636-5914-6022.description:
Activate any number of creatures you control by tapping them, adding at least {1}{G}{U}.
Cast Quickling by paying {1}{U}.
When Quickling enters the battlefield, it, Clement and Intruder Alarm trigger.
Resolve the Intruder Alarm trigger, untapping all creatures.
Holding priority, activate any number of creatures you control by tapping them, adding at least {1}{G}{U}.
Resolve the Clement trigger, returning nothing to your hand.
Resolve the Quickling trigger, returning Clement from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Clement by paying {1}{G}{U}.
When Clement enters the battlefield, it and Intruder Alarm trigger.
Resolve the Clement trigger, returning Quickling from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Intruder Alarm trigger, untapping all creatures.
Repeat.
1636-5914-6022.notes: You can tap Frogs for mana thanks to Clement. This should be factored in when determining if you have enough mana to execute the combo.

1878-2634-5195-5957.notablePrerequisites:
Kianne's power is odd.
An opponent has four or more cards in hand.
1878-2634-5195-5957.description:
Cast Jeska's Will by paying {2}{R}.
Storm-Kiln Artist triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Holding priority, activate Rootha by paying {2} and returning it from the battlefield to your hand, copying Jeska's Will.
Storm-Kiln Artist triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Jeska's Will copy, adding at least {R}{R}{R}{R}.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {U}.
Cast Rootha by paying {1}{U}{R}.
Repeat from step 4.
1878-2634-5195-5957.notes: If you control a commander, you can choose both of Jeska's Will's modes if desired.

2866-4970-5751-6289--49.description:
Cast Chromatic Sphere from your graveyard by paying {0} and discarding an artifact land card from your hand.
Activate Chromatic Sphere by paying {1}, tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1} and causing you to draw a card.
Scrap Trawler triggers, returning an artifact land card from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

2921-4200-6132.notablePrerequisites: You have enough mana to cast Icewind Stalwart.
2921-4200-6132.description:
Cast Icewind Stalwart by paying its mana cost.
When Icewind Stalwart enters the battlefield, it triggers, targeting Metamorphosis Fanatic.
Holding priority, activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Icewind Stalwart.
Resolve the Icewind Stalwart ability, blinking Metamorphosis Fanatic.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Icewind Stalwart from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

413-1228-5470.notablePrerequisites:
You have a way to create a creature token this turn.
Goblin Sharpshooter does not have summoning sickness.
413-1228-5470.description:
Create a creature token.
Activate Goblin Sharpshooter by tapping it, creating a copy of the creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing a creature token.
When the creature token dies, Goblin Sharpshooter triggers, untapping itself.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat from step 2.

457-2538-5034-5390.description:
Cast Sol Ring by paying its mana cost.
Forensic Gadgeteer triggers, creating a Clue token.
Activate Urza's first ability by tapping the Clue, adding {U}.
Activate Sol Ring by tapping it, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Words of Wind by paying {1}, replacing the next card you would draw by causing each player to return a permanent to their hand instead.
Activate the Clue by paying {1} and sacrificing it, causing you to return Sol Ring from the battlefield to your hand, and causing each opponent to return a permanent they control from the battlefield to their hand due to Words of Wind.
Repeat.

1824-4924-5554.notablePrerequisites:
You have not completed and are not venturing in Tomb of Annihilation.
You control a Treasure token or a Gold token.
1824-4924-5554.description:
Cast Acererak the Archlich by paying {B}.
Oltec Matterweaver triggers, creating a copy of a Treasure or Gold token you control.
When Acererak the Archlich enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, returning it from the battlefield to your hand, and venturing into Lost Mine of Phandelver.
Activate a Treasure token by tapping and sacrificing it, or a Gold token by sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.

1170-1766-2032-2369-5261.notablePrerequisites:
You have an instant card exiled with Isochron Scepter that does not remove a permanent and/or counter a spell, and that has legal targets, if needed.
Kiora has at least three loyalty counters on it.
1170-1766-2032-2369-5261.description:
Activate Kiora's loyalty ability twice by removing two loyalty counters from it, untapping Thran Dynamo and Isochron Scepter.
Activate Thran Dynamo by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Activate Isochron Scepter by paying {2} and tapping it, casting a copy of the exiled card without paying its mana cost.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Kiora.
Resolve the copy of the instant card.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite mana, you may untap any other permanent using Kiora.

2173-3558-4050-5220.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Crookshank Kobolds
When Crookshank Kobolds dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Crookshank Kobolds from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Cast Crookshank Kobolds from the top of your library by paying 0 life.
Repeat.

2689-3173-3368-5231.notablePrerequisites: You control another creature with power seven or greater.
2689-3173-3368-5231.description:
Cast Fling by paying {1}{R} and sacrificing a creature you control with power seven or greater.
Holding priority, cast Reiterate with buyback by paying {4}{R}{R}, creating a copy of Fling and returning Reiterate to your hand.
Resolve the Fling copy, causing you to create at least seven 3/1 Elemental Shaman creature tokens with haste due to Hostility.
Activate Thermopod seven times by sacrificing seven Elemental Shamans, adding seven {R}.
Repeat from step 2 an arbitrarily large number of times.
Activate Thermopod's second ability by sacrificing Hostility, adding {R}.
Hostility dies, shuffling itself into your library from your graveyard.
Cast Reiterate with buyback by paying {4}{R}{R}, creating a copy of Fling and returning Reiterate to your hand.
Resolve the Fling copy, dealing at least seven damage to any target.
Repeat from step 8.

3059-3231-5253.notablePrerequisites: Brion does not have summoning sickness.
3059-3231-5253.description:
Activate Brion by paying {R}, tapping it and sacrificing Malignus, dealing damage equal to two times Malignus's power to target opponent and causing you to gain that much life.
The opponent loses the game due to having 0 or less life.
